principle: Register every current first-party build/ owner. Preserve historical CMake/Conan trees and do not move or delete compiled caches automatically.

android.purpose: Android platform build output when selected

automation.purpose: Editor and application automation scratch/IPC runtime

compat.purpose: XP/legacy compiler, Conan and platform compatibility cache

conan-config.purpose: Conan configuration and first-party hook overlays

desktop.purpose: Platform and Release/Dist objects, Conan generators and executables

host.purpose: Native host tool CMake build and executables

sdk.purpose: Selected SDK staging or isolated SDK build work

shader-cache.purpose: Content-addressed shader compiler cache shared by builds

tests.purpose: Disposable source test compiler/probe workspaces, plus non-destructive retired-root archive

validation.purpose: Run receipts, validation evidence and source-patch backups

mobile.purpose: Native Android/iOS target objects, toolchain generators, Gradle staging

jni.purpose: Desktop JNI native CMake and Conan target caches

consumers.purpose: Independent installed-SDK regression consumers and stock runtime caches

cleanup_policy: Existing test roots may be relocated only explicitly, with preflight and no clobber. Never automatically delete caches, evidence, or source.
